Like many people here I had the same issue with my (NON-PRO) Surface 3. Surface App didn't recognize my device and I couldn't change the pen's pressure curve and other options.

The most obvious symptom is the generic icon (instead of a realistic icon) of your Surface when you open "Devices and Printers". For some people, refreshing a few times while there will fix the issue. It didn't for me, through 2 different installs.

Luckily I stumbled upon this post: https://answers.microsoft.com/en-us/surface/forum/surf3-surfupdate/surface-app-not-working-on-surface-3-clean-install/f58288eb-6564-4684-a5a9-09c7824995bc?page=2 (all credit goes to that guy, I just did what he suggested).

So, without further bla-bla, the issue is missing device metadata, and to fix it, you only need do this:

  1. Download device metadata (pulled from Surface 3 Windows 8.1 install): https://www.dropbox.com/s/aieppmdiu8sivh3/surface3-non-pro-device-metadata.zip?dl=0
  2. Extract the ZIP somewhere (Desktop is a good candidate)
  3. Open Explorer and go to: %ProgramData%\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceMetadataStore (paste it into the address bar)
  4. Drag the file extracted at (2) to the folder above
  5. Open "Devices and Printers"
  6. Refresh

At step (6) you should see the generic icon change to a realistic Surface 3 icon. The metadata file is copied from a Windows 8.1 restore, I had to actually go back to 8.1 since I couldn't pull it directly from the recovery image (coudn't merge the 2 SWM files into a WIM - kept getting errors).

PS: I assume the same steps would fix the issue on the SP3 (with a different metadata file), but I don't have one to test.
How to fix Surface App and pen issues on the (non-pro) Surface 3
